ideas.title: Investigating the Child Care Funding Freeze in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the cause of the child care funding freeze in Minnesota and its impact on families.
questions: What is the cause of the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover larger issues with the child care system in Minnesota and potentially other states. By following the money, we may be able to determine the cause of the funding freeze and its impact on families.
